batting.name: KK Nair
batting.dismissal: st RV Uthappa b Shakib Al Hasan

batting.name: SV Samson
batting.dismissal: c MK Pandey b SP Narine

batting.name: SR Watson
batting.dismissal: c SA Yadav b SP Narine

batting.name: STR Binny
batting.dismissal: c RN ten Doeschate b R Vinay Kumar

batting.name: SPD Smith
batting.dismissal: c SA Yadav b R Vinay Kumar

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c R Bhatia b SR Watson

batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c SV Samson b SR Watson

batting.name: MK Pandey
batting.dismissal: st SV Samson b PV Tambe

balls.text: slower ball, Bhatia gets under it and launches it over deep midwicket boundary
no hat-trick for the bowler as Faulkner pushes this to deep midwicket for a single

another good catch in the deep! this time it's Tendo.. Binny whacked the low full toss straight towards deep midwicket.. Tendo was slightly inside the boundary and was expecting it to drop down towards him.. but that was hit hard and didn't look like coming down.. in the end he had to time his leap to get to that..
slower delivery, he looks for the big hit, but his timing is awry and that lobs up gently for the long on fielder
fires a good yorker on off, the batsman digs it out to deep midwicket
he prepares for the switch hit early, gets a slower ball and whacks it over point.. but doesn't get much behind it.. the ball is pulled in by Gambhir
makes room and tries to hoist it over extra cover, but misses as this turns away ..
he come down the pitch and swings across the line.. gets it on the middle.. it wouldn't have mattered which way it was spinning.. that sails over deep midwicket
now Binny tries to go inside out over extra cover, but misses and could be stumped here..He has just managed to keep his back foot inside the line

tossed up!! And what about that catch! KKR are pulling these blinders in this IPL.. Watson had reached the pitch of the delivery and it was well on his way over the long-on boundary.. But Surya waits at the edge of the boundary, and stretches outward to take that brilliantly.. He manages to keep his balance too.. Wonderful effort
fires it on the pads, Watson works it away behind square on the leg side for a quick couple
swings his bat across the line to pick up a single to wide long on
length delivery outside off, this is clubbed to wide long off..but just a single
gets the yorker on the target, the batsman punches it down to long on
Watson was clearly irked by the previous ball as he throws his bat at this fuller delivery .. he gets a thick outside edge, but it lands safely beyond the reach of short third man running backwards

what was that! Russell looked like he was pulling out of the run up.. but he continues.. and bowls it outside off.. what was that! Nigel Llong didn't see that because the bowler was behind him.. Watson is confused and he is protesting with the umpire.. Llong - the other day he reprieved Dwayne Smith because the towel fell off Shakib's trousers..
bowls a half-volley outside off, that is crashed through extra cover, but straight to the man in the deep
a high full toss this time! the batsman throws his bat at that and gets a top edge back down the ground.. Too high .. it's called a no-ball
wow!! Binny gets away from it just in the nick of time.. That low full toss was murdered back down the pitch
this is down the leg side, it flicks the pads to roll to fine leg
watches the away-going delivery carefully, dabs it to cover for a single
slower this time, the batsman presses forward and pushes it softly to midwicket.. Binny wanted two, but is sent back
flatter and quicker on the stumps, the batsman punches it back to the bowler
marginally short and Sanju makes a good connection with his pull shot, but that has gone higher than longer and is comfortably taken by Pandey at deep midwicket
plants his front foot out and punches this to long on
pushes this to long off for a single
another gift .. this is a full delivery outside off, Watson won't mind these at all.. He clubs this down the ground, over the bowler's head
gets a slower delivery and he throws his bat at that, but finds the man at deep midwicket
fires that wide yorker.. this would have been a wide has Watson not stuck his bat out.. They pick up a single to cover
now a low full toss wide outside off, that has been hammered through extra cover
that's a gift to Watson.. a half-volley outside off, Watson clubs it over long-on with ease.. thank you very much
shuffles across to the off side this time before charging down the pitch, gets a toe end to deep square leg
pushes the offspinner down the ground, Narine does the fielding
this one is off the middle! He moves to leg side and punches this flatter delivery over point for a good couple of runs
comes down the pitch, is beaten by the doosra, fortunately for him, he gets a thick outside edge that runs fine through off side
bowls it too short, Watson pulls it hard along the ground, but there is protection at deep midwicket
looks to flick it towards midwicket, but ends up chipping it past the non-striker for a single
goes back to punch this, but it keeps coming in with the angle, the batsman pushes it to cover
quicker on on the middle and leg line, again, Watson finds the man at midwicket
another one fired flat.. but this way down the leg side
bowls a flatter delivery on the pads, the batsman punches it straight to midwicket

he misses out on his half-century! That was smartly bowled by Shakib. He saw the batsman making a move down the pitch and fired it full outside off.. Nair was stranded down the pitch.. no chance for him
moves the leg side and drives the fuller delivery to deep cover
bowls a low full toss outside off and it's driven to wide long off.. where Manish Pandey and Surya almost make a hash of it.. But they end up giving away only one extra run
floats this one very wide .. outside off.
this is a poor delivery! It was one of those offcutters, but RTD bowls this one down the leg side.. Karun just helps it on its way, flicking it over short fine leg for a boundary
swings his bat across the line to the length delivery, but can only find the man at deep midwicket
fuller, quicker and on the pads, it's flicked to deep backward square leg
good work by Gambhir at backward point! He dives to his left and saves a certain boundary as the batsman had got enough bat on that
full and flighted on the middle, the batsman squeezes it out to cover point for a single
looks to punch this offcutter through off, but gets a thick outside edge to short third man
another full delivery, this time outside off, he slices it to deep backward point for a couple

he has cleared the man at deep square leg! That looked like a leading edge to me.. it was a low full toss on the pads and the batsman was aiming to play it fine, but closes the face too early.. The edge has enough to send it all the way though
there is some force in this back foot punch, but Sanju hits it straight to deep cover
moves to the leg side and gets a slower ball, he punches it to deep midwicket for a single
he is lucky as this edge lands just behind the bowler! That was going nowhere as he tries to flat-bat this short of length delivery down the ground only to get a thick top edge
and bowls a slower delivery to start with, Sanju plays his attempted guide to third man a touch too early to be beaten
fires a good yorker outside off, the batsman digs it out back to the bowler
another slower ball, but this is too full and on the pads too, easily flicked over square leg for a couple to the deep
moves a touch to the leg side and gets a short of length delivery on the body, he chops it to short third man for a single
smart bowling.. This is slower outside off, the batsman works it away to deep midwicket
looks to reverse paddle this length delivery, but is a touch late and is beaten.. Uthappa is standing up to the stumps
slower delivery outside off, the batsman slices it to short third man for a single
uses his feet and gets a high full toss that he punches to deep cover
he has won that call! That was by the wide marker outside off.. No signal from the umpire
flatter delivery but Nair was down on his knee early for a sweep shot, he gets a big top edge but that lands safely at deep backward square leg
comes down the pitch and almost yorks himself, still manages to push it to long off for a single
looks to push this to the off side, but gets an inside edge to midwicket to pick up a single
floated up outside off, the batsman pushes it to cover for a single
he comes forward and drives this on the up to wide long on for a single
fires this one on the pads, the batsman misses his flick but picks up a leg bye towards the off side
another slower delivery, this was full and it's driven to deep cover for a single
that's a good response from Russell.. A slower delivery just outside off, it bounces a touch extra too and beats the outside edge
that's neatly done too! This is a length delivery wide outside off, Sanju makes no effort to keep it down, slicing it over point
bowls a fuller delivery on off, easily punched to long on for a single
he comes forward and defends the floated delivery to cover
comes forward and dabs this softly to the vacant midwicket region
comes down the pitch but Shakib bowls this wide outside off, he has to adjust and he does that well, stretching forward to drive it to deep cover
goes deep in the crease and punches the flatter delivery to deep midwicket
goes on the back foot and pushes the fuller delivery to the right of midwicket softly
full and flighted, on the pads, the batsman dabs it towards square leg for a quick single
this is beautifully played! It was a good short of length delivery outside off, Samson just opens the bat face very late to run it down fine on the off side.. third man had no chance
back of length delivery on the body, Karun clips it off his hips to fine leg
looks for the yorker, but bowls a low full toss outside off, easy delivery for Sanju who drives it to deep cover

direct hit has cut short Rahane's innings! or has it? It always looked like a risky single. Karun flicked the short of length delivery straight to short fine leg... It just went too quickly to the fielder.. Narine does well and throws down the stumps at the striker's end. Rahane dived.. but was always going to be short
back of length delivery outside off, the batsman defends it to point
on the  pads! How many times have we seen this today, Karun flicks it to deep backward square leg
shorter from Narine and Rahane stands up tall to punch this through cover! Lovely timing there, although not a great effort by the cover fielder who allowed it to go through.. Quick 50 for RR already
he comes forward and defends this one solidly down the pitch
cross-batted shot comes out since he has no clue where this is spinning, picks up a single to deep square leg
woo! that's a big doosra! Squares up Karun completely. He gets an outside edge, but that falls short of slip
that's the straighter one! Karun had no idea. He was playing for the turn and gets beaten
bowls an offspinner, easily worked away to deep square leg for a single
comes down the pitch, but has to defend as he is not to the pitch of the delivery
tossed up, but this is on the pads, Rahane dabs it to midwicket for a single
uses his feet and drives the fuller delivery down to long off for a single
another sweep, another boundary at the same area.. This one was more of a top-edge as he was looking to hit this hard
that's a neat sweep shot! It was always coming in from the angle Shakib bowls with and Karun just helps it along its way, bisecting the gap between short fine leg and backward square leg
floated up on off stump, Karun pushes it to cover
fires it down the leg side..
short and wide, it's steered down to third man for a single
comes forward and nudges the length delivery to deep square leg for a single
this one has sailed all the way! More runs at fine-leg! He charges down the pitch, got a good slower delivery, but the batsman just carries on with his flick shot
easily done! He was trying to play the same shot off the last ball.. this time he does it well. Full on the middle, Rahane just chips it over midwicket for a boundary
looks to flick it to the on side, but this was just outside off. The batsman gets a leading edge towards mid-off, but it drops well short
this one is quick! it skids off the surface and beats the outside edge as Rahane looks to punch it off the back foot
short of length and on the body, easily clipped to backward square leg for another single
this one is crisply timed off the back foot! It was short enough for that kind of shot, but Surya at cover dives to his left to cut it off
finally outside off, but this one was asking to be hit. It was short and wide, the batsman punches it straight to cover point
more runs at fine leg! This is on the middle stump line, Rahane just has to close the face and bang.. couple of easy runs
they are bowling on the pads - maybe that's the plan - Rahane flicks this one fine and picks up a couple as the fine leg was squarer
bowls it slow and bowls it full, Rahane flicks it to deep backward square leg as the line is too straight
on the pads again, easily nudged to fine leg for a single
looks for the outswinger, but ends up bowling a low full toss, punched to mid-off
now he bowls it full on the pads, Karun doesn't have to do much, he just wrists it behind square leg and it looks set for the boundary, but RTD saves a single with a dive
short and wide, Karun is the man with the confidence of a fifty behind him, he waits an extra second and cracks it through backward point
strays on to the pads and easily tickled to fine leg, that was off the thigh pad actually
length delivery on off stump, easily defended to square leg
appeals for an lbw but this is an ambitious shout as the ball pitched on leg stump and didn't straighten enough
gets this to shape away from short of length, Karun has a poke at it and misses
length delivery on off stump, Karun stays in the crease and defends this solidly to mid-on
this one is too straight again, there is some shape on it but Rahane dabs it to midwicket for a single
corrects the line, gets this one to shape away a touch outside off, the batsman defends it to off
bowls full on the pads and Rahane will flick them all day, he does it neatly past the square leg umpire
they have done it again! Royals, take a bow. Surya gets some bat on this, but can only hit it to deep square leg
superb yorker! this is done and dusted now. Shakib digs it out to long on
low full toss, he can only hit it to mid-off for a single.. The match is almost gone now
slower bouncer, Surya was down on his knees and lets this one go over him.. Looks to the umpire, but this one is not called wide
he misses out on this full delivery! This could have been flicked anywhere and he takes it on the pads
he charges down the pitch and drives it to cover, but can't beat the fielder.. Just a single
another no-ball.. ! He oversteps from round the wicket.. this would have been a wide down the leg side too
bowls a slower yorker! Surya misses his sweep and only gets a leg bye.. Not a good choice of shot with fine leg placed at the boundary

what a time to overstep! it was a good length ball and Shakib had missed it.. Was just about to finish a good over, but he has given an extra ball.. Huge no-ball. The keeper didn't take it cleanly, giving away a single
fuller delivery, that is some firm hit! But this is straight down to long-on, just a single.. KKR running out of time here
gets a short one on the body and pulls it down to deep backward square leg.. Tambe runs around from fine leg and keeps them to one
another yorker, this time Surya manages to squeeze it to wide long on for a single
superb yorker at 137 kph! Surya just brings his bat down in time to dig that one out
he charges down the pitch, gets a slower bounces, but he plays a double-handed fore-hand down to long-on for a single
Watson drops it at mid-off! Shakib hammers the low full toss, Watson moved to his left, dived, got both hands to it, but couldn't hold on..
fuller delivery outside off, Shakib is bringing back KKR to life.. Breath by breath.. He smashes it over extra cover for a boundary
bowls a bouncer this time, but this is down the leg side.. Who is holding that pressure bowl now?
Up, up and over! Shakib gives this length ball his all, swings and swings bit to hoist it to the sight screen
he looks to sweep this round-the-wicket yorker and gets hit on the pads, but that hit him outside the line of  leg stump
he charges down the pitch and looks to drive it through the off side, but plays inside the line and is beaten
bowls a slower delivery, but this too far down the leg side
short of length delivery, Shakib gets a single to long on with a flat-batted swipe
looks to smash it over deep square leg, but this slips under the bat
fires this on the body, the batsman manages to nudge it down to fine-leg
he comes out of the crease and chips the slower delivery in the gap at midwicket.. Calls for a couple and makes it back in time
fuller on the stumps, Surya shuffles across and whips it to deep backward square leg
length delivery on the stumps, Shakib calmly drives it down to long on
length delivery outside off, the batsman punches it in the air almost into the hands of mid-off.
full and flighted outside off, the batsman drives it down to long off for a single
it's a googly, but it's short enough for Shakib to go back and punch it to midwicket
flatter on the pads, Surya nudges it to square leg for a single
pushed through outside off, Surya chops it on to point

Tambe, you beaut!!! he is got the hat-trick! Tendo watches the umpire for some time.. He is surprised but the call.. but this is over.. He tossed it up, Tendo was coming forward to play and gets hit on the toe on full.. that is an excellent decision.. What drama!
this is madness! Yusuf has got a golden duck! This was full and Yusuf drives it back to the bowler.. KKR are imploding in the most incredible fashion
he is gone! Common sense is up in smoke! Manish walks out of the crease far too early and Tambe fires this down the leg side.. He had no chance
length delivery on off, the batsman drives it straight to cover.. no run

he has knocked the middle stump down! perfect slower delivery! The batsman moved to the leg side and played down the wrong line.. Watson gives him a cold stare of death..no words.. The eyes said it all
good short ball that flies close to the batsman's gloves! Watson asks the umpire for a caught behind, but that didn't touch anything
second one in three balls now! Slower delivery, Uthappa flicks it straight to deep square leg.. that didn't even threaten the boundary.. Tame dismissal. Never too far from some late drama
no dramas from Watson.. he bowls a good yorker that Russell blocks out on the crease. Robin charges down all the way and was going to struggle has Watson hit the stumps, they get a single
Watson strikes first ball! Gambhir cleared his front leg out and was looking to crash it over extra cover, but gets a thick outside edge to the keeper
looks to play a reverse paddle to an angled delivery, makes no connection
fuller on the pads, driven straight to midwicket
misfield at short third man by Bhatia allows an extra couple.. It was a simple chopped shot to the fielder, but he takes his eyes off the ball
gets into a tangle as he tries to whip it to the leg side, gets hit on the body but gets a single to short third man
on the pads and Gambhir gets to his half-century with a swipe to deep backward square leg boundary.. relief writ over his face
length delivery on off, Gambhir punches it straight back at the bowler
this is superbly timed! Robin waits in the crease for this really slow ball and even though he only gets a toe end to it, manages to clear the rope straight behind the bowler
fails to get bat on a leg-sidish delivery, but picks up a leg bye
he has seen enough of the slower ones from Bhatia! He charges down the pitch and gets it on the middle of the middle of the bat.. That has sailed deep over wide long on, into the stands
fuller on off, creams it to long-off for a single
much slower and on the pads, Gambhir waits in the crease, then pulls it to deep square leg to bring up the 100 of the stand
he charges down the pitch and smashes this down the ground to long on
he fails to beat the man at short fine leg with his crisply timed sweep
he works it away to deep square leg for another single
another outside edge for Gambhir as he looks to slog the googly to the leg side! Again, it lands short of backward point
steps out of the crease and flicks the fuller delivery to deep square leg
tossed up delivery on the pads, the batsman drives it to wide long on for a single
Gambhir wants to impose himself! He steps out again and gets this one off the middle.. There is not much timing, but he manages to hit in the gap at deep midwicket
slower and on the stumps, Robin stays back and punches it to long on
now Gambhir looks to smash Tewatia out of the ground, but gets an outside edge to short third man
another one tossed up outside off, this time Robin drives it to long off for a single
tossed up wide outside off, the batsman drives it straight to extra cover
he greets the bowler with a neat strike over long off! That's Robin's fifty too.. it was beautifully timed, no real effort there really
gets a legcutter and chooses to play straight, punches it to long on for a single
fires in a yorker outside off, Gambhir manages to dig it out to deep midwicket
he misses out on this one! It was a high full toss and Robin was looking to guide it down the leg side, but misses.. Bhatia appeal for lbw, but that would have missed leg
the offcutter now, Gambhir clears his front leg and sweeps it powerfully to the leg side, but straight to the man at deep square leg
slower legcutter on the stumps, Robin waits in the crease and punches it to long on for a single
back of length delivery on off, this is the quicker one, the batsman defends it to cover
nothing unconvincing about this one! He gets a short ball and he rocks back to thwack it over midwicket for his 300th IPL boundary
now he is almost beaten by a googly! He looks to drive through extra cover, but gets a thick outside edge that lands short of short third man
he is very lucky again! Gambhir throws his bat at this wide delivery and gets a toe-end to it, it just loops over the point fielder
now Robin steps out of the crease and flicks it to deep square leg
loopy delivery, Gambhir is out of the crease and drives it along the ground to long on
bowls it slow on off stump, Robin picks up a single to midwicket with a soft dab
very slow from Tewatia, the batsman goes deep in the crease to punch it to long on for a single
looks to work the wrong 'un away to the leg side, but gets hit on the pads
flatter and wider outside off, Gambhir waits and then punches it to deep cover
tossed up on the pads, the batsman nudges it to backward square leg for a single
comes round the wicket and pushes it through outside off, Gambhir punches it off the back foot to deep extra cover
tossed up delivery on the stumps, he dabs it to midwicket for a single
he waits in the crease and punches the length delivery to deep midwicket
another slower delivery on the stumps, Gambhir, Bhatia's IPL teammate for six IPL seasons not to mention the times spent in Delhi, dabs it to short fine leg for a single
another slower ball, this time it's not as full as the last ball, Uthappa comes forward and punches it to long on
slower delivery! This was spotted very very early by Uthappa, who clobbers it over deep midwicket.. This has gone a long long way
back of length delivery outside off, Gambhir waits for it and then runs it down to short third man for a single
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman comes forward and punches it calmly to long on
gets a yorker wide outside off and he squeezes it out to deep backward point for a couple
now inside out! this is even better! He moves to the leg side and drives the full delivery over extra cover.. That's a sign of Gambhir's confidence really
he makes little room by moving to the leg side and smashes the length delivery over mid-on for another boundary.. Gambhir is finding his way back
length delivery on the pads, Robin is quick to flick this to deep square leg
sharp bouncer from Southee! Robin is surprised and doesn't expect it to rise so high, misses his pull shot
charges down the pitch but finds the man at midwicket as this hits the inside half of the bat
slower delivery, it bounces a touch extra and Gambhir defends it to point
now Gambhir gets the bat behind it! It's full and on the stumps, Gambhir just presses forward and whacks it over midwicket for a boundary
heaves this length delivery across the line and manages a single to deep square leg as it comes off the inside half of the bat
length delivery outside off, Uthappa comes forward and punches this on the up straight to mid-off
looks to pull the short of length delivery, but doesn't get hold of it.. It lands safely, way short of deep midwicket
very lucky for Gambhir this one! He was looking to punch this full delivery through midwicket, but gets a thick leading edge that flies in the gap at extra cover
he stretches forward and pushes this to wide mid-on, but Faulkner dives across from midwicket, gets a hand to the ball and fuels hesitation.. Uthappa turns down the single
on the pads, Robin stays on the back foot and punches it to deep midwicket for a couple
comes down the pitch and just chips it over mid-on for another boundary! That was smart as he didn't try to hit it out of the ground, just a neat punch
lots of air on this one, Uthappa takes it on the full and drives it straight to cover
tossed up and full on the pads, Gambhir is down on his knees early and sweeps it to deep midwicket
tossed up delivery on off, Uthappa comes forward and drives it down to long off for a single
short of length delivery on off, Uthappa takes a smart single by dropping this one to the off side
he almost times it into the hands of the cover fielder! It was full and wide, the batsman comes forward and drives it to cover, but lands just short
thick outside edge, but there is only one slip in place and this flew through second slip.. It was another outswinger and he drew the batsman into it
length delivery on the pads, Uthappa easily tickles it past the short fine leg .. Tambe gives it a chase, but cannot keep it in
length delivery on the stumps, Gambhir dabs it close to the stumps and calls for a quick single
length delivery outside off, the batsman looks to punch this through off but gets an inside edge back to the bowler
superbly hit through wide mid-on! It was angled in on to the stumps and Uthappa went on with his drive, threading the gap between midwicket and mid-on
comes forward and drives the full and wide delivery through extra cover, not much timing behind that one, but it gives him three
goes wide of the crease and hits the pads as Uthappa misses his flick, but that was heading down the leg side
he slaps this length delivery firmly, but hits it straight to mid-off
a brute of an outswinger! It's pitched on length and slightly shapes away to beat the outside edge.. Uthappa was looking for the on-the-up drive
bowls it full in the channel outside off, Uthappa comes forward and punches it back to the bowler
short delivery first up to Gambhir, the batsman goes for the pull but makes no connection
oh what timing! Uthappa meets this outswinger under his eye and times it beautifully, but straight to the man at cover, who has a shy at the striker's end and gives away an extra run
another outswinger.. This is wide outside off and keeps going away to beat the outside edge
slightly short in length and Uthappa is quick to swivel on his toes and whip it over midwicket for the first boundary
another one shaping away from the batsman, Uthappa stretches forward and pushes it back to the bowler
bowls a gentle outswinger, the batsman lets it go through
